text:
deploybot: Heads-up: starting ratcheted kernel+quant rollout in quiet window at 02:30 UTC. Staged traffic slices: 1%, 5%, 20%, then 100. Pin TTL will be 30m for the first two slices. See rollout args below and ack.
alex: ack. which regions in first slice?
deploybot: first slice: us-west1 only. second slice: us-west1 + eu-west1. full: all regions.
maya: ping @linh can you watch p95 and evictions on us-west GPUs during the 1% slice? baseline dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/boards/runtime/quant-canary
linh: watching. adding a small log tail: `kubectl logs -f svc/runtime-canary -n staging --since=10m` — will dump to #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
jorge: quick note: we've included the new matmul v3 kernel. it's ABI-compatible but exercise path differs under short context lengths. Expect small perf variance on <64 tokens.
alex: what's rollback criteria? need explicit numbers to automate.
maya: propose: >2% error rate (4xx/5xx) sustained for 3 minutes OR p95 latency increase >35% vs baseline for 5 minutes OR GPU OOMs > 0.5 per minute sustained for 3 minutes.
deploybot: noted. automated rollback will trigger if any criterion met during a slice. manual rollback path: `deploybot rollback --tag canary-matmulv3 --reason "auto/manual"`
linh: will also watch KV cache hit rate and steady-state throughput. If cache miss rate rises >10pp, call rollback.
jorge: test note: staging run earlier showed a CPU-side stall under long prompts (>3k tokens). we added a guard for streaming backpressure; monitor stream error rates separately.
alex: release notes blurb drafted: "Engine: upgraded matmul kernel (v3) + quant packing fix; initial canary on us-west1; expect improved throughput for mid-length prompts." Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-kernel-matmulv3
maya: small operational ask: shorten pin TTL to 10m on the 5% slice if we see flapping so deploybot can unpin faster. Otherwise default 30m.
deploybot: config for this rollout:
```
rollout: ratcheted
slices: [1,5,20,100]
regions: [[us-west1],[us-west1,eu-west1],[us-west1,eu-west1,us-east1],[*]]
pin_ttl_minutes: [30,30,60,120]
auto_rollback_criteria: ["err_rate>2%:3m","p95>35%:5m","oom_rate>0.5/min:3m"]
```
linh: +1. I'll post quick bookmarks to the three dashboards and the tail link in #eng-oncall before cut.
maya: ops-bot do you have capacity for a standby nodepool in us-west1 to pop if we need a hot fallback?
ops-bot: standby pool available (2 gpus). can attach in ~4m via `opsctl attach-pool --region us-west1 --pool standby-quick`.
jorge: if we need to pin older kernel on the fly: `deploybot pin --model runtime:matmulv2 --reason "fallback" --ttl 60m` — tested yesterday.
alex: who will file the post-rollout note? need perf numbers (token/sec, p95, error delta) and any rollbacks.
maya: I'll own post-rollout notes and push a short summary to #eng-release within 30m of completion.
linh: smokewatching now. will call if any anomalies. good luck.
deploybot: rollout started: slice 1 at 02:30 UTC. monitoring channels: #eng-runtime, #eng-oncall. I'll post every slice transition.
alex: thanks. :thumbsup:
maya: :eyes:
deploybot: slice 1 complete, metrics within thresholds. unpin step skipped, TTL still counting (20m left).
linh: no evictions, p95 +2% only. KV hit steady.
deploybot: slice 2 (5%) started.
maya: dropping a quick smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` shows stable streaming.
deploybot: slice 2 holding at 5% — 12m elapsed.
maya: saw a tiny p95 blip to +38% for 90s around minute 7, but recovered. not sustained.
linh: confirmed transient, no OOMs.
deploybot: slice 2 complete, metrics within thresholds. moving to slice 3.
alex: go for slice 3. reminder: if flapping reappears, switch pin_ttl to 10m as discussed.
deploybot: starting slice 3 (20%). pin_ttl set to 60m for this slice as per plan.
maya: monitoring. will update release note draft with token/sec numbers after 10m.
deploybot: slice 3 saw p95 +8% and throughput +12%. no auto-rollback triggers. commencing full rollout in 5m if no regressions.
deploybot: full rollout initiated.
ops-bot: standby pool attached to us-west1 for hot fallback.
maya: full rollout done. no rollbacks. drafting postmortem (short) in docs.
alex: great run. thanks everyone. please add any odd findings to the doc.
